description: Rank AI build tools and coding-agent harnesses for an app idea, with deterministic, documented scoring (no LLM): number of shipped apps on Vibe Shipped per tool, apps matching the idea, platform (web/mobile), coding experience, budget vs stated official pricing (with checked dates and source links), and a preferred harness. Each result has a score breakdown, pricing, and example apps with Vibe Shipped links.

budget_usd_month.description: Monthly budget in USD for the tool (0 = free only)

idea.description: The app idea in plain text

preferred_harness.description: Slug or name of a preferred tool/harness, e.g. claude-code

name: recommend_stack
title: Recommend an AI build stack
